definitions: The act of spending an entire day or extended period in bed, often engaging in passive activities like watching TV or using a phone, typically due to a lack of motivation or as a form of self-care.
A period of intentional inactivity and relaxation spent in bed, often involving media consumption.
examples: Her weekend was dedicated to bed rotting.
He needed some serious bed rotting after a stressful week.
Bed rotting can sometimes be a sign of burnout.
